_comment: The cross-commons bridge graph, vendored and pinned: Fashion Cabinet garments to Yantra4D hardware through hardware_ref (the forward claims), and Yantra4D hardware to its Fashion Cabinet consumers through the back-edge fashion-cabinet publishes for yantra4d to vendor. Both directions are kept because they come from two different published files; whether they agree is checked, not assumed. unlinked_claims is fashion-cabinet's own report of the claims that do not resolve, carried verbatim — the reader reports them and never fails on them, matching the back-edge convention. Refresh with scripts/refresh_reader_snapshots.py.

unlinked_claims.reason: Co-create target, now BUILT upstream (span/knots resolve against the pinned snapshot) — but changpao and jeogori-jacket still carry linked:false. Flipping them is a cartridge change, not an index change: each needs its params_map re-checked against the solid's sew_tail flange and the dimensional handshake satisfied. Tracked as the first re-point candidate.

No Yantra4D solid models a hammer loop's stiffening insert yet; the FC-400 index carries it as `yantra4d/hammer-loop (co-create)`. painters-pant keeps an honest placeholder until the solid is built upstream. This is the one claim in the repo that does not resolve against the upstream catalog at all.

The Yantra4D solid exists and is vendored, but hi-vis-vest's placeholder predates it and maps a parameter the solid does not have ('overlap_mm'; the solid exposes strip_length / strip_width / sew_margin). Honest linked:false until the placket math is re-expressed against the real parameter set — a false link would resolve by name and lie about the geometry.
